title: Assurance ecosystem worker dropped the planned local mod closure

source_observation.environment: Full no-reuse 3.2.5 post-publication calibration on merged dev 49b6e7f55ee13be30ae81dfe6dc48e8d33cfa67e, exact immutable 3.2.5 and 3.2.3 packages, Factorio 2.1.13, and explicit C:\Projects\Factorio\testmods\2.1 closure.
source_observation.fact: The plan fingerprinted the supplied mod-lock and closure, but runtime.ecosystem invoked the release gate without --mods <mods>. The child gate then substituted its absent default C:\Projects\Factorio\testmods_2.1 and failed before ecosystem qualification.

reproducer.command: .\tools\mir.ps1 verify run --target 2.1 --profile full --candidate dist\more-infinite-research_3.2.5.zip --prior dist\more-infinite-research_3.2.3.zip --factorio <exact-2.1.13> --mods C:\Projects\Factorio\testmods\2.1 --no-reuse --plan build\results\terminal-calibration\3.2.5-convergence-plan-dev49.json
reproducer.expected: runtime.ecosystem forwards the exact mod closure that its plan fingerprint bound, so the release gate cannot substitute a workstation default.
reproducer.observed: The exact run produced blocked capsule 25BDEC6DCCA7288F45C82656D9CF675339DA626B429710BECC7E7F93FE1377D5 and failed with 'Local mod directory does not exist: C:\Projects\Factorio\testmods_2.1'.
